info.title: Al-Ameen Clinical Speech Therapy Academy API
info.description:
## Overview
Comprehensive RESTful API (`v1`) for all **Public**, **Auth**, and **Student** features of the **Al-Ameen Clinical Speech Therapy Academy LMS Platform**.

All endpoints share **100% of their business logic** with the Web (Blade/Livewire) interface via the unified Service Layer (`app/Services/`).

---

## Environment Variables (Apidog Setup)
Configure the following environment variables in **Apidog -> Environments**:

| Variable | Default Value | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `BASE_URL` | `http://localhost:8000/api/v1` | Base URL for all API v1 requests |
| `BEARER_TOKEN` | *(auto-filled on login)* | Sanctum Personal Access Token (`Authorization: Bearer {{BEARER_TOKEN}}`) |
| `LOCALE` | `ar` | Active response language (`ar` or `en`) |
| `COURSE_SLUG` | `comprehensive-speech-therapy-diploma` | Default course slug or ID for testing |
| `LESSON_SLUG` | `1` | Default lesson slug or ID |
| `TASK_ID` | `1` | Default clinical task ID |
| `SUBMISSION_ID` | `1` | Default clinical task submission ID |
| `CERTIFICATE_CODE` | `ALAMEEN-2026-8F92A` | Default certificate verification code |
| `NOTIFICATION_ID` | `9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d` | Default notification UUID |
| `TICKET_ID` | `1` | Default support ticket ID |
| `PASSKEY_ID` | `1` | Default WebAuthn passkey ID |

---

## Request Body Format (`multipart/form-data`)
All `POST`, `PUT`, and `DELETE` endpoints accept **`multipart/form-data`** (form-data key/value fields and file uploads) as well as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.

---

## Localization
Pass `Accept-Language: ar` or `Accept-Language: en` (or `X-Locale: ar|en` / `?lang=ar|en`) on any request to receive localized model attributes (`title`, `description`, `instructions`) and validation messages.

---

## Authentication & Approval Workflow
1. Register via `POST /auth/register` — new student accounts are created with `status = pending` awaiting admin approval.
2. Once `status = active`, authenticate via `POST /auth/login` (or Firebase / Google / Passkey) to receive a Sanctum `token`.
3. Pass `Authorization: Bearer {{BEARER_TOKEN}}` on all `/auth/me`, `/auth/logout`, and `/student/*` endpoints.

---

## Useful Links
- **Interactive API Reference**: [http://localhost:8000/api/v1/docs](http://localhost:8000/api/v1/docs)
- **Live OpenAPI 3.0.3 JSON**: [http://localhost:8000/api/v1/openapi.json](http://localhost:8000/api/v1/openapi.json)

get.summary: Get platform branding, currencies, feature flags, and supported locales
get.description:
Fetches the global bootstrap configuration required to initialize web or mobile clients on startup.

- **Service**: `PublicContentService::getBootstrapConfig()`
- **Authentication**: None (Public)
- **Includes**: Active locale, RTL direction flag, supported locales (`ar`, `en`), currency symbol/name, manual payment accounts (`vodafone_cash_number`, `instapay_handle`), and student page visibility flags.

get.summary: Verify a certificate publicly by its unique certificate code
get.description:
Publicly verifies the authenticity of a student's completion certificate using its unique `certificate_code` (scanned from the certificate QR code or entered manually).

- **Service**: `CertificateService::verify(string $code)`
- **Authentication**: None (Public)
- **Rate Limit**: `throttle:certificate-verify`

post.summary: Switch active language (ar / en) and sync with authenticated profile if signed in
post.description:
Switches the active application locale (`ar` or `en`), updates the session/cookie locale, and if the caller is authenticated, persists the preference to `users.locale`.

- **Service**: `LocalizationService::setLocale(string $locale, ?User $user)`
- **Request Body**: `multipart/form-data` (`locale`: `ar` or `en`)

requestBody.description: Form-data payload containing the target locale (`ar` or `en`).

locale.description: Target language code (`ar` for Arabic RTL, `en` for English LTR)

post.summary: Register a new student account (created in pending status awaiting admin approval)
post.description:
Registers a new student account in the platform.

- **Service**: `StudentAuthService::register(array $input)`
- **Account Status**: Newly registered accounts default to `status = pending` and require administrator approval before `/auth/login` issues a token.
- **Request Body**: `multipart/form-data`

201.description: Account registered and pending admin approval

value.message: تم إنشاء حسابك بنجاح وهو الآن قيد المراجعة من قِبل إدارة المنصة.

LoginAfterApproval.description: Once approved by administration (`status = active`), authenticate via `POST /auth/login`.

post.summary: Login with email and password to receive a Sanctum Bearer token (or 2FA challenge)
post.description:
Authenticates an approved student account (`status = active`) using email and password.

- **Service**: `StudentAuthService::attemptLogin()`
- **2FA Support**: If Two-Factor Authentication is enabled on the account, returns `status = two_factor_required` and `data.two_factor_token` (valid for 5 minutes) to be verified at `POST /auth/two-factor-challenge`.
- **Apidog Environment Tip**: Map `$.data.token` to your `BEARER_TOKEN` environment variable in Apidog Post-Processors.

device_name.description: Device or client name for the Sanctum token

value.message: يرجى إدخال رمز المصادقة الثنائية لإتمام تسجيل الدخول.

GetAuthenticatedProfile.description: Fetch the authenticated student's profile using the issued Bearer token.

post.summary: Verify 2FA login challenge using a 6-digit TOTP code or recovery code
post.description:
Completes a Two-Factor Authentication login challenge initiated by `POST /auth/login`.

- **Service**: `StudentAuthService::verifyTwoFactorChallenge()`
- **Provide either**: `code` (6-digit TOTP from Google/Microsoft Authenticator) OR `recovery_code` (one of the emergency recovery codes).

recovery_code.description: Emergency recovery code if TOTP device is unavailable

device_name.description: Device identifier for the issued Sanctum token

value.message: تم التحقق من رمز المصادقة الثنائية وتسجيل الدخول بنجاح.

post.summary: Authenticate or register using a Firebase ID Token
post.description:
Verifies a Firebase Authentication ID Token (JWT) and issues a Sanctum Bearer token.

- **Service**: `StudentAuthService::loginWithFirebase()`
- **Rate Limit**: `throttle:firebase-auth`

id_token.description: Firebase ID Token JWT obtained from Firebase Client SDK

post.summary: Generate WebAuthn Passkey authentication assertion challenge options
post.description:
Generates a short-lived WebAuthn `PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions` challenge (`challenge_id`) for passwordless passkey login.

- **Service**: `PasskeyService::generateLoginOptions(?User $user)`

requestBody.description: Optional student email to scope allowed passkey credentials.

VerifyPasskeyLogin.description: Verify the WebAuthn assertion using the returned `challenge_id`.

post.summary: Verify WebAuthn Passkey assertion and issue a Sanctum Bearer token
post.description:
Verifies the browser/OS WebAuthn `PublicKeyCredential` assertion against the cached `challenge_id` and issues a Sanctum Bearer token.

- **Service**: `StudentAuthService::loginWithPasskey()`

value.message: تم تسجيل الدخول بواسطة مفتاح المرور (Passkey) بنجاح.

post.summary: Send a 6-digit password reset OTP code to the student's email
post.description:
Generates a 6-digit numeric OTP code and emails it to the student for password recovery.

- **Service**: `PasswordSecurityService::sendResetOtp(string $email)`
- **Rate Limit**: `throttle:otp`
- **Next Step**: Call `POST /auth/verify-otp` to validate the 6-digit code.

requestBody.description: Form-data with the student's registered email address.

value.message: تم إرسال رمز التحقق المكون من 6 أرقام إلى بريدك الإلكتروني بنجاح.

VerifyOtpCode.description: Verify the 6-digit OTP sent to the student's email.

post.summary: Verify a 6-digit password reset OTP code before resetting password
post.description:
Checks whether a 6-digit password reset OTP code is valid and not expired without consuming it yet.

- **Service**: `PasswordSecurityService::verifyOtp(string $email, string $otp)`
- **Rate Limit**: `throttle:otp`
- **Next Step**: Call `POST /auth/reset-password` with the same `email`, `otp`, and new `password`.

otp.description: 6-digit numeric OTP code received via email

value.message: رمز التحقق صحيح. يمكنك الآن تعيين كلمة المرور الجديدة.

ResetPasswordWithOtp.description: Submit the new password along with the verified OTP code.

post.summary: Reset student password using the 6-digit email OTP code
post.description:
Consumes the 6-digit email OTP, updates the student's password, and if the student account is `active`, issues a fresh Sanctum Bearer token.

- **Service**: `PasswordSecurityService::resetPassword(array $credentials)`
- **Rate Limit**: `throttle:otp`

device_name.description: Device name for issued Sanctum token
